agent_instructions: This file contains full geometry, collision, pathing, and placement data extracted from Cosmoteer vanilla Terran part .rules files under Data/ships/terran.  All coordinates are in local tile space with the origin at the top-left corner of the unrotated part.  One tile = one grid cell = 64 in-game units.  Fields that are null were not defined in the rules file; see the per-field inline descriptions in each part record for the default behaviour when a field is absent.  Arithmetic expressions (e.g. 7/64, 400%) have been evaluated to their numeric results.  Angle values that had a 'd' suffix (degrees) are stored as plain numbers. FIELD REFERENCE — size=[w,h]: full tile footprint including decorative overhang (barrel, nozzle). physical_rect=[x,y,w,h]: core-body sub-rect; physics AABB when bounding_rect_type=Physical. save_rect=[x,y,w,h]: grid cells owned in save files; null=full size. bounding_rect_type: 'Physical'=use physical_rect for AABB, null=use full size. rect_collider_rect_type: 'Normal'=force full-size rect collider despite physical_rect. generate_rect_collider: false=no auto rect collider (part supplies polygon_colliders). allowed_door_locations: [[x,y],...] valid door-edge positions (may be outside footprint). external_walls_by_cell / internal_walls_by_cell: [{tile:[x,y],value:[sides...]},...] per-cell wall overrides; sides=TopLeft|Top|TopRight|Left|Right|BottomLeft|Bottom|BottomRight|None. external_walls / internal_walls: uniform wall specs for whole part; values=All|None|[sides...]. no_auto_doors: true=suppress automatic door graphics. generator_requires_door: false=part has no crew space and never needs a door. door_access_warning_level: 'Weak'=accessible but not recommended. blocked_travel_cells: [[x,y],...] tiles impassable to crew. blocked_travel_cell_directions: [{tile:[x,y],value:[dirs...]},...] one-way movement blocks; dirs=Up|Down|Left|Right. force_manhattan_path: true=cardinal-only pathfinding inside part. crew_speed_factor: movement speed multiplier (0=impassable, 1=normal). crew_congested_speed_factor: speed multiplier when cell is crowded. cell_occupancy_factor: affects pathing cost. is_rotateable: false=symmetric part, no rotation needed. selection_priority: higher=preferred for cursor selection. selection_type_id: editor multi-select group. selection_type_by_rotation: true=each facing is a distinct selection group. flip_h_rotate / flip_v_rotate: [r0,r1,r2,r3] rotation-index remapping when mirrored. create_part_per_tile_when_grabbed: non-null=split into per-tile parts on pickup. circle_colliders: [{component,location,location_ref,radius,density},...] circle physics colliders in local part space; location_ref set when position is a runtime &reference. polygon_colliders: [{component,vertices:[[x,y],...],density},...] convex-polygon physics colliders in local part space. turret_weapons: [{component,location:[x,y],rotation_deg},...] turret pivot points (centre of rotation) and default facing in degrees. BACKWARD-COMPAT FIELDS (same structure as vanilla_parts_geometry.json) — display_name: English display string from Data/strings/en.rules. price_resources: [{resource,amount},...] build cost from the Resources block. geometry: sub-object with size, selection_type_id, is_rotateable, collider_type (PolygonCollider|null), polygon_vertices (base rotation), footprint_tiles (base rotation), and per_rotation dict keyed '0'–'3'. Each per_rotation entry: rotation_index, size, polygon_vertices, allowed_door_locations, blocked_travel_cells, footprint_tiles, unblocked_footprint_tiles. doors: sub-object with allowed_locations (same as allowed_door_locations). travel: sub-object with blocked_travel_cells, crew_speed_factor, crew_congested_speed_factor, cell_occupancy_factor. inheritance_chain: list of rules file paths from root base to this part.
